WITH matched_units AS (
  SELECT s.sentreg, t.ordertypedist AS order_type_mix, s.instownpct AS ownership
  FROM sentimentandfundamentals AS s
  JOIN transactionrecord AS t ON s.transref = t.transreg
  WHERE t.ordertypedist IS NOT NULL
    AND s.instownpct IS NOT NULL
), mix_baselines AS (
  SELECT order_type_mix, AVG(ownership) AS mix_baseline
  FROM matched_units
  GROUP BY order_type_mix
), overall_baseline AS (
  SELECT AVG(ownership) AS overall_average
  FROM matched_units
), kept_units AS (
  SELECT u.ownership, b.mix_baseline, o.overall_average
  FROM matched_units AS u
  JOIN mix_baselines AS b ON u.order_type_mix = b.order_type_mix
  CROSS JOIN overall_baseline AS o
  WHERE u.ownership > o.overall_average
)
SELECT AVG(ownership) AS average_kept_ownership,
       AVG(ownership / mix_baseline) AS average_ownership_to_mix_baseline_ratio,
       AVG(ownership - overall_average) AS average_excess_overall_average
FROM kept_units;

assumptions.assumption: Units missing institutional ownership are ignored in the mix baselines, overall average, and kept-unit calculations, consistent with SQL AVG ignoring NULL values.
